metric: Translations from SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL into six databases' dialects, proved equal to the source in the source's dialect after sqlglot reads both; parsed means both sides parse in their own dialect.
correctness: Every BIRDTrans proof is re-run on 300 random SQLite databases (DuckDB translations also natively in DuckDB); 539 pairs where the two databases read the same text differently (LIKE case, MySQL collation, integer division, SQLite type conversion) are left unproved. 1/203 'approximate' pairs are proved (listed in the docs). 22 of the exact proofs are a MariaDB translation that is its MySQL source token for token, where the provers have nothing to read (an INSERT, a table with no published definition); statements whose answer can change between two runs are refused.
caveats: Pinned subset of the 6,402 pairs (every approximate pair, one in ten of the rest); run --data with a DLBench checkout for all. Labels are LLM plus human review, not proofs. Proofs are about sqlglot's reading of each dialect; MariaDB is read as MySQL and MonetDB as PostgreSQL. The 32-bit float, division-by-zero, decimal and ClickHouse rules were added after a first run on the whole subset showed two proofs contradicted natively in DuckDB (tuned on test). The 2026-11-11 harness changes (translated column and table spellings read back, the same-statement rule) were developed on the development split only.
